card.name: Linking words in drug interaction warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and word parts right inside drug-interaction statements, just before the interacting drug or risk is named (e.g. after 'drugs', 'with MAO', 'co').

modes.label: Before interacting drug class
modes.description: A comma or 'with' or 'that' after a list of drugs, just before the next interacting drug or effect.
modes.example: o Observe patients overnight if at higher risk of symptomatic bradycardia, heart block, prolonged QTc interval, or if taking drugs<< with>> known risk of torsades de pointes

modes.label: Inside MAOI and co-administration
modes.description: The ending of MAOIs or the 'co' of coadministration in warnings about combined use.
modes.example: MAOI) Clinical Impact The concomitant use of SSRIs and SNRIs including desvenlafaxine extended-release tablets with MAO<<Is>> increases the risk of serotonin syndrome.
